messages:
Maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — we need to update the runbook for GPU OOMs and add a clearer escalation path. cc @Ajay @Sara
incident-bot: Postmortem created: /postmortems/INC-2025-08-02 (auto-generated)
Ajay: +1. Propose three action items: 1) add explicit triage commands + example outputs, 2) decision tree for when to failover to fallback models, 3) monitoring queries to detect recurring patterns (KV cache misses, batching spikes).
Sara: I can own the triage commands and the decision tree. Planning a PR by end of week.
Tim: I'll take the monitoring queries and write a detection rule for recurring incident patterns (spike correlation p50/p95 + cache-miss ratio).
Kai: Can we include runnable snippets in the runbook? e.g.
```
# dump recent logs for inference workers
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=inference --since=10m --tail=200
# restart a single worker deploy
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deploy/inference-worker
# trigger route fallback (internal API)
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/v1/routes/fallback -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN' -d '{"route":"llm-high"}'
```
Maria: Good — let's assign owners + firm due dates so this doesn't drift. Suggested: Sara -> triage commands PR (runbooks repo) due 2025-08-15; Tim -> monitoring ticket + rule due 2025-08-18; Ajay -> update escalation doc and add PD escalation sequence due 2025-08-20.
Ajay: :thumbsup: I'll also add a checklist item in the release playbook to smoke-test the runbook after edits.
Sara: Quick question: for escalation steps, do we include direct phone numbers? Security asked to avoid PII in docs. Maybe reference PagerDuty policies instead.
Maria: Don't include phone numbers in the runbook. Add a PD escalation section that points to the PD policy and the alias `#oncall-inference` for immediate pings.
Tim: I'll open the monitoring ticket and attach a query example. Pattern we noticed: ~30% of these incidents correlate with sudden increases in batch size when quantized models hit long tail sequences. Will codify that.
Kai: Also add a "who to cc" field in the postmortem template: ops-leads, model-owner, infra-sre. Saves a follow-up loop.
Maria: I'll create a meta checklist PR that links all items (triage commands PR, monitoring ticket, escalation doc PR). Assigning myself to coordinate and nudge weekly.
incident-bot: Follow-up reminder scheduled for 2025-08-19T10:00:00Z. Attendees: Maria, Ajay, Sara, Tim.
Sara: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/459 — contains triage commands and decision tree. Please review.
Ajay: Left comments on PR #459, requesting clearer step numbers and a short blameless checklist at the top.
Tim: Monitoring ticket created: https://tracker.redwood/tickets/AI-789 — includes sample PromQL and threshold suggestions.
Maria: Action summary (from thread): Sara — PR459 (triage commands & decision tree) due 2025-08-15; Tim — AI-789 (monitoring & detection rule) due 2025-08-18; Ajay — PR460 (escalation + PD sequence) due 2025-08-20; Maria — PR461 (meta-checklist linking all items) due 2025-08-16. Ping me if anything slips.
Kai: :raised_hands: thanks everyone, looks actionable.
